description:
Title: Work and Live in Austria

Please check the requirements for working and living in austria.
Create a process that assists you for a combination of the steps.

Include:
* Organizing accomodation and bank account (negotiation)
* Visa (every x amount of months) - Rot-Weiss-Rot Card  

Requirements  
General principles and requirements for the issue of Visas:  
* visa application form 
* a travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months and with at least two empty pages, that was issued within the last ten years 
* a passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm) in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria 
* presentation of an fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay (amount of cover: 30.000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area) 
* proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence 
* other evidence requested by the relevant authorities (hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment etc.) - as these are adapted to local standards and coordinated with other Schengen representations, the evidence to be provided may vary depending on location 
* absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country)  

Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested.
Please contact the representation in advance for more information.

Generally speaking, all visa types are issued by representation offices (→ BMEIA) abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension of the visa is permitted, by the state police headquarters.

Schengen visas must be issued by the representation office of the country in which the main travel destination of the visa applicant is located.
If the applicant intends to spend an equal amount of time in several countries (for example, when touring), the competent representation office is that of the country in whose territory the main travel destination is located, on the basis of the length and purpose of the stay.
If it is not possible to determine a main travel destination, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible for issuing the visa.

Territorial competence for applications for category A and C visas falls to the representation office in the consular district where the legal place of residence of the applicant is located.
A representation office may claim exceptional competence for applications from third‑country nationals legally residing but not registered in their district if the applicant can provide justification as to why they had to submit their application to that particular consulate.

Type D visas, however, must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation.
The provisions of Section 8 of the FPG apply to type D visas.
In accordance with these provisions, the territorial competence for carrying out official actions in relation to visas is determined on the basis of the foreign national's the place of residence (i.e. their centre of interest, verifiable by means of e.g. registration forms, residence permit, visa).

A list of all representation offices (addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours, special requirements for issuing visas etc.) can be found on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLive" name="Begin work and living arrangements"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SplitArrangements" name="Arrange in parallel" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PeriodicVisa" name="Prepare and submit visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application (every x months)">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">another periodic application is due at the stated interval (x months)</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:documentation>The interval is stated as x months; its numeric duration is not specified.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsultRepresentationInformation" name="Consult representation information in advance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Consult the representation for more information and check the BMEIA website for addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours, and special requirements. Additional documents may be requested depending on the circumstances.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaCategory" name="Visa category" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineMainDestination" name="Determine Schengen main travel destination">
        <bpmn:documentation>For equal time in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MainDestination" name="Can a main destination be determined?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectMainDestinationCountry" name="Select country of the main travel destination"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry" name="Select country of first Schengen entry">
        <bpmn:documentation>Use the country of first entry if a main travel destination cannot be determined.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeDestination" name="Schengen responsible country identified" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectACConsularDistrict" name="Identify representation in consular district of legal residence">
        <bpmn:documentation>For category A and C applications, territorial competence falls to the representation office in the consular district where the applicant legally resides.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" name="Does exceptional competence apply?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" name="Justify application to exceptional representation">
        <bpmn:documentation>For a third-country national legally residing but not registered in the consular district, provide justification for applying to that particular consulate.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeACRepresentation" name="Category A or C representation identified" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDRepresentation" name="Identify competent Austrian representation for type D visa">
        <bpmn:documentation>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. Section 8 of the FPG applies; territorial competence is based on place of residence or centre of interest, verifiable with evidence such as registration forms, a residence permit, or a visa.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeVisaCategory" name="Visa representation route identified" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IssuingLocation" name="Where may the visa be issued?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Representation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UseRepresentation" name="Use representation office abroad"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UseBorderPost" name="Use border control post in a specific exceptional case"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UseStatePoliceHeadquarters" name="Use state police headquarters where visa extension is permitted"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeIssuingLocation" name="Issuing office identified" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareVisaApplicationForm" name="Prepare visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document">
        <bpmn:documentation>The document must be valid in Austria, remain valid at least three months beyond the visa duration, have at least two empty pages, and have been issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePassportPhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
        <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport-photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ArrangeTravelHealthInsurance" name="Arrange fully comprehensive travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Cover the planned duration of stay, provide EUR 30,000 cover, and be valid throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence" name="Provide proof of sufficient means">
        <bpmn:documentation>Show sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other evidence requested by the authorities">
        <bpmn:documentation>Examples include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket, and proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary by location.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGroundsForRefusal" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
        <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional documents requested"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocuments" name="Additional-document check complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitVisaApplication" name="Submit visa application to competent office"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaCycle" name="Visa application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V01" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_ConsultRepresentationInformation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V02" sourceRef="Task_ConsultRepresentationInformation" targetRef="Gateway_VisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VAC" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">categoryIsAOrC</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VD" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaCategory" targetRef="Task_SelectDRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">categoryIsD</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V03" sourceRef="Task_DetermineMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_MainDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDestinationYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectMainDestinationCountry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">mainDestinationCanBeDetermined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MainDestinationNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MainDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">mainDestinationCannotBeDetermined</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V04" sourceRef="Task_SelectMainDestinationCountry" targetRef="Gateway_MergeDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V05" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry" targetRef="Gateway_MergeDestination"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V06" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeDestination" targetRef="Task_SelectACConsularDistrict"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V07" sourceRef="Task_SelectACConsularDistrict" targetRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExceptionYes" name="Exceptional competence applies" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">exceptionalCompetenceApplies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExceptionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_MergeACRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">exceptionalCompetenceDoesNotApply</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V08" sourceRef="Task_JustifyExceptionalCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_MergeACRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V09" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeACRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeVisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V10" sourceRef="Task_SelectDRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeVisaCategory"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V11" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeVisaCategory" targetRef="Gateway_IssuingLocation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Representation" name="Generally" sourceRef="Gateway_IssuingLocation" targetRef="Task_UseRepresentation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BorderPost" name="Specific exceptional case" sourceRef="Gateway_IssuingLocation" targetRef="Task_UseBorderPost">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">specificExceptionalCase</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extension" name="Visa extension permitted" sourceRef="Gateway_IssuingLocation" targetRef="Task_UseStatePoliceHeadquarters">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">visaExtensionPermitted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V12" sourceRef="Task_UseRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeIssuingLocation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V13" sourceRef="Task_UseBorderPost" targetRef="Gateway_MergeIssuingLocation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V14" sourceRef="Task_UseStatePoliceHeadquarters" targetRef="Gateway_MergeIssuingLocation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V15" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeIssuingLocation" targetRef="Task_PrepareVisaApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareVisaApplicationForm" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V17" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_PreparePassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V18" sourceRef="Task_PreparePassportPhoto" targetRef="Task_ArrangeTravelHealthInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V19" sourceRef="Task_ArrangeTravelHealthInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V20" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeansOfSubsistence" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V21" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_CheckGroundsForRefusal"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V22" sourceRef="Task_CheckGroundsForRefusal" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalDocumentsRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noAdditionalDocumentsRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V23" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V24" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V25" sourceRef="Task_SubmitVisaApplication" targetRef="End_VisaCycle"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinArrangements" name="Accommodation, bank, and visa steps complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLive" name="Work and living arrangements prepared; visa application submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_WorkLive" targetRef="Gateway_SplitArrangements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitArrangements" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitArrangements" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitArrangements" targetRef="SubProcess_PeriodicVisa"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_JoinArrangements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_JoinArrangements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="SubProcess_PeriodicVisa" targetRef="Gateway_JoinArrangements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinArrangements" targetRef="End_WorkLive"/>
  </bpmn:process>
